description: One stdout line of the claude CLI's stream-json output (without its newline) and the events it gives, before the adapter applies them. Anything unrecognized gives no events: an unknown type, a field of the wrong type, a line that is not a JSON object. The line is read as Foundation's JSONSerialization reads it (HK-393; rust/powerup-core/src/json/mod.rs lists every rule): valid UTF-8 with one optional leading byte order mark (a stray 0xA9 byte inside a string reads as U+FFFD), one U+FEFF at the start of any string dropped, first of two equal keys wins, one trailing comma accepted, a number that overflows a double rejects the line, a value may begin only while at most 512 containers are open. Fields are read as Swift reads them through NSNumber (HK-394): a bool is the number 1 or 0, the numbers 0 and 1 are bools. Text lengths count extended grapheme clusters (HK-063). In a controlResult, action is the raw request_id and value is null; the adapter swaps in the recorded subtype and value.
function: ClaudeService.events(fromLine:) ↔ powerup_core::harness::claude::parse::events_from_line — input: a line input (a string, the line as UTF-8, or {"hex": <bytes>} for bytes that are not text); expected: a list of claude event descriptors
verifiedBy: DESIGN.md v1.1 A (verified live against claude CLI v2.1.243); Tests/PowerUpTests/HarnessFixtureTests.swift testClaudeStreamTable plays it through ClaudeService.events(fromLine:), which parses through the bridge since slice 2.3. Rust: rust/powerup-core/tests/harness.rs claude_stream_cases runs events_from_line.
capturedAgainst: The Swift parser (JSONSerialization) of PowerUp at 7404080, built with Swift 5.9.2 (Xcode 15.2) and run on macOS 27.2; the wire shapes themselves were verified live against claude CLI v2.1.243 (DESIGN.md v1.1 A)

cases.name: a space carrying a combining mark is not a separator

cases.name: an emoji with a skin tone is kept whole at the cut

cases.name: a conjunct is one character at the cut
cases.reason: Unicode 15.1 grapheme rules (GB9c) join a Devanagari conjunct into one character, as Swift's String does on current macOS (HK-063).

cases.name: one trailing comma is accepted

cases.name: a trailing comma in an array is accepted
cases.reason: Foundation accepts one trailing comma after the last element (HK-393).

cases.name: two trailing commas are rejected
cases.reason: Only one trailing comma is accepted (HK-393).

cases.name: a lone comma in an empty object is rejected

cases.name: trailing text is rejected
cases.reason: One line holds one value (HK-393).

cases.name: a trailing NUL is rejected

cases.name: a raw tab inside a string is rejected
cases.reason: Control characters must be escaped inside strings (HK-393).

cases.name: a NUL escape is accepted

cases.name: an escaped surrogate pair is one character
cases.reason: \u escapes join surrogate pairs; \/ is a slash (HK-393).

cases.name: a lone surrogate escape is rejected
cases.reason: Foundation refuses an unpaired surrogate, so the whole line is ignored (HK-393).

cases.name: a high surrogate followed by a letter is rejected
cases.reason: A high surrogate must be followed by a low one (HK-393).

cases.name: an unknown escape is rejected
cases.reason: Only JSON's escapes are read (HK-393).

cases.name: invalid UTF-8 is rejected
cases.reason: The line must be valid UTF-8; a stray byte makes Foundation refuse the whole line (HK-393).

cases.name: a stray 0xA9 byte in a string reads as U+FFFD
cases.reason: The one stray byte Foundation reads instead of refusing the line, measured on macOS 27.2 for every byte from 0x80 to 0xFF (HK-393).

cases.name: a stray 0xA9 byte outside a string is rejected
cases.reason: Outside a string Foundation refuses it like any other stray byte (HK-393).

cases.name: an encoded surrogate is rejected
cases.reason: UTF-8 never encodes a surrogate (HK-393).

cases.name: a cost too large for a double is rejected
cases.reason: Foundation refuses a number that overflows a double, and with it the whole line (HK-393).

cases.name: a negative overflowing number is read
cases.reason: Foundation refuses only a positive overflow: a negative one of at most 17 significant digits reads as minus infinity, so the line stands (HK-393).

cases.name: a cost too small for a double reads as 0
cases.reason: A number that underflows reads as zero (HK-393).

cases.name: a long integer cost reads as the nearest double
cases.reason: Integers beyond 64 bits still read as numbers (HK-393).

cases.name: a leading zero is rejected
cases.reason: JSON numbers have no leading zeros (HK-393).

cases.name: NaN is rejected
cases.reason: NaN is not JSON (HK-393).

cases.name: single quotes are rejected
cases.reason: Strings use double quotes (HK-393).

cases.name: a comment is rejected
cases.reason: JSON has no comments (HK-393).

cases.name: a value inside 512 open containers is read
cases.reason: Foundation reads a value that begins while at most 512 containers are open (HK-393).

cases.name: an empty container that is the 513th is read
cases.reason: The 513th container may begin; nothing may begin inside it (HK-393).

cases.name: a value inside 513 open containers is rejected
cases.reason: Past Foundation's depth limit the whole line is ignored, so a deep line cannot exhaust the parser's stack either (HK-393).
